summary: Gravel pull-off beside the bush road, with cars parked, backing onto forest.

best_section.where: Gravel pull-off on the north-west side of the road bend, about 30 m south-west of the pin

drivers.seclusion: Forest behind and around it; no buildings in the data or imagery.
drivers.access_and_room: Wide gravel apron meets the road edge; several cars sit on it in the QLD image, so a van fits.
drivers.traffic: Bends in a through road to the lookout; passing cars, but the van stands clear of the lane.
drivers.convention: Four or five cars parked there in QLD imagery, so stopping is normal.

flags: Pin itself is steep bush (mean 12%); the pull-off is a few metres off the pin and gentler, but the DEM samples don't cover it
Lift gate 92 m away has a mapped way round it
sun_shade: Part shaded by trees from the north-west and east; open gravel to the road side.
cannot_judge: Whether parking is restricted at night
